Game Overview

Collect the Rain is a skill game built around guide a bucket through a charming, animated world as you collect raindrops with precision and speed. Enjoy vibrant graphics while enhancing coordination and timing skills. The pace picks up, challenging you to anticipate and adapt for high scores. Perfect for kids and enjoyable for all!
